release_notes: Ranger S2 5MP (marketed on imou.com as DK2 5MP), the 5MP '3K QHD' variant of the DK2 / Ranger S2 indoor Wi-Fi pan & tilt series. Separate record from the 3MP Ranger S2 (IPC-DK2-3H1W). Imou's spec table on the 5MP page still lists the shared DK2 4MP sensor/resolution/FOV block, so those 4MP-specific hardware values were deliberately NOT carried into this 5MP record; only 5MP-confirmed and platform-common fields are recorded. Exact 5MP SKU not confirmed from an official source.
